content.short: Alandale is a ve(3,3) liquidity market on Robinhood Chain that routes swap fees to lockers.
content.description: Alandale operates a ve(3,3) liquidity market on Robinhood Chain, taking swap fees from pools and directing them to those who lock the governance token and vote on emissions. The mechanism ties reward allocation to the pools that actually produce fees, rather than leaving it to a schedule set in advance.
